# Lightyear Studios

> High-performance digital engineering & commercial creative production studio specializing in custom software development, web applications, SaaS platforms, PaaS, ERP systems, restaurant management systems (POS & commission-free ordering), 4K commercial video production, and performance digital marketing.

Lightyear Studios operates globally with a dedicated focus on Australian businesses (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide) and international enterprises. Founded and directed by Hamza Malik.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Software & Web Engineering](https://kravinoffs.agency/software-portfolio): Custom websites, high-speed web apps (React, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript), full-stack SaaS platforms, enterprise ERP business engines, and cloud PaaS infrastructure.
- [Restaurant Management & POS Tech](https://kravinoffs.agency/services#restaurant-pos): Specialized restaurant POS systems, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), real-time table management, and 100% commission-free online food ordering web applications.
- [Commercial Video Production](https://kravinoffs.agency/video-portfolio): Cinema-grade commercial video production, product video showcases, high-converting social media reels, and post-production video editing delivered up to 4K UHD across 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1 aspect ratios.
- [Digital Marketing & Growth](https://kravinoffs.agency/services#marketing-plans): Transparent monthly marketing packages including Digital Presence (A$990/mo), Growth Engine (A$1,900/mo), and Market Leader (A$3,500/mo) covering SEO, AEO, GEO, and Meta/Google Ads.
- [Studio Provenance & Founder](https://kravinoffs.agency/about): Operating details, Lahore engineering hub, global Australian delivery model, led by Studio Director Hamza Malik.
- [Direct Contact & Project Briefing](https://kravinoffs.agency/contact): Online project briefing and direct WhatsApp consultation.
